Leaders and Institutions Mark Doctors' and CAs' Day

Prime Minister Narendra Modi extended greetings to doctors and chartered accountants on their respective days. In other related events, Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy also conveyed wishes to chartered accountants. The Indore Municipal Corporation recognized both doctors and chartered accountants on these occasions.
